status: authored model candidate; player art acceptance pending
intent: A curious, tough little survey tug with overlapping beetle shell plates, a recessed horizontal visor and two hooked side shields. Creepy-cute through proportions and silhouette, not painted cartoon eyes. Broad shoulders, narrow ventral machinery, visible gaps and recessed propulsion; no copper trim or spherical cockpit bubble.
units: meters; Y up, forward -Z; flight pivot at hull center

rig.motion: Shields cant outward with actual thrust and independently trim against steering; damped, bounded angles. Pause freezes the rig. No continuous creature-like flapping.

review: front, rear, side, top and underside
normal flight at 29 m and far flight at 95 m
exhaust and beams follow transformed sockets
no gameplay balance changes from model geometry
